slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover looping background video for the whole hero section (muted, autoplay, playsInline), sitting behind all content under a 50% black overlay (bg-black/50) for legibility. The single signature media asset; native placeholder is a CloudFront .mp4 URL.

Single UI typeface applied throughout the section (navbar, badge, heading, subtitle, both CTA labels). font-medium and font-normal weights are used. Native family 'General Sans', loaded from Fontshare.

Navbar brand wordmark on the left, rendered in white at 187px wide x 25px tall. Native placeholder is a 'LOGOIPSUM'-style mark; supply as a transparent/currentColor white lockup so it reads on the dark video.
Small 14px white chevron-down arrow repeated to the right of each nav link (14px gap label-to-arrow). Single glyph reused across the four nav items; supply as a currentColor white icon.
Tiny 4px solid white dot inside the 'Early access available from' badge pill, preceding the text. A trivial round mark; native value is a CSS dot, only fill if a brand wants a custom bullet glyph.

mechanic: A static fullscreen hero stacks a spread navbar and a vertically-centered, 40px-gapped content column (badge pill, gradient-clip heading, subtitle, white pill CTA) over a looping muted background video dimmed by a 50% black overlay.
techDelivery: single-file CDN Tailwind + Babel + esm.sh React 18 (utility classes drive layout; General Sans loaded from Fontshare).
reskinNotes: The headline is a background-clip:text gradient (linear-gradient ~144.5deg, white ~28% to transparent black ~115%) baked inline, so a brand recolor means editing that gradient, not a token. Both CTA buttons are a layered pill construction (0.6px white outer border + inner black/white pill + a blurred white-to-transparent glow streak along the top edge) hardcoded around white-on-dark; the nav button is black-fill and the hero button is white-fill, so they don't share one token. All copy is hardcoded in markup (eyebrow 'Early access available from' + ' May 1, 2026', headline 'Web3 at the Speed of Experience', the EOS subtitle sentence, both 'Join Waitlist' labels, and the four nav labels). Layout magic numbers (56px heading at line-height 1.28 with max-width 613px, 680px subtitle width, 280px/200px top padding, 120px nav padding) are tuned to General Sans's metrics and the specific copy lengths.
